name: Envelope and tracking budget modes
description: Actual supports envelope and tracking engines, and defaults to envelope when no budgetType preference exists.
user_problem: A single budget model does not suit both cash allocation and plan-versus-actual tracking.
benefit: Users can select cash-envelope budgeting or a tracking-oriented budget.
uncertainty: Preference conversion and recomputation were not exercised. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/base.ts

name: Monthly category activity totals
description: For a category and month, sum-amount totals signed transaction amounts within month bounds from on-budget accounts.
user_problem: Category balances must include transactions assigned to that category, not only account balances.
benefit: Month sheets recompute category activity when transaction date, account, amount, category, tombstone, or parent status changes.
uncertainty: The query also relies on v_transactions_internal_alive filters; inspect that view before treating this as the complete ledger rule.

name: Envelope category balance formula
description: Expense balance equals current budgeted amount plus signed activity plus prior balance selected by the carryover setting.
user_problem: Users need a category balance reflecting assignments, spending, and prior funds.
benefit: The spreadsheet derives reactive monthly available funds for each expense category.
uncertainty: Formula uses signed transaction amounts; transaction sign conventions are defined elsewhere.

name: Positive balance carries forward
description: With carryover off, a new month takes max of prior category balance and zero, preserving positive funds but clearing negative balances.
user_problem: Category surplus should remain available after month end.
benefit: Positive underspend persists without requiring manual reassignment.
uncertainty: This is category availability, not a cash account balance.

name: Default overspending reduces next To Budget
description: Summary sums prior-month negative expense balances only where carryover is disabled and includes that amount in next month To Budget.
user_problem: Unfunded spending must be reconciled against future allocation.
benefit: By default, an overspent category becomes a next-month To Budget reduction instead of a continuing negative category balance.
uncertainty: This applies only to expense categories without rollover enabled.

name: Category carryover toggle
description: Carryover is stored per month and category in the active budget table from a selected start month through created months.
user_problem: Users may need different overspending behavior for different categories.
benefit: A category can retain negative balances across months rather than reducing next month's To Budget.
uncertainty: The action writes the selected flag for all created months at or after startMonth. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/envelope.ts

name: Income roll-forward into available funds
description: Envelope available funds equal current income activity plus prior month To Budget plus selected buffered amount.
user_problem: Income left unassigned at month end must remain budgetable.
benefit: Unbudgeted income flows into the following month's available funds.
uncertainty: Income is recognized by is_income category metadata.

name: To Budget summary formula
description: To Budget combines available funds, negative non-carried overspending, negative total expense assignments, and held funds.
user_problem: Users need a consistent amount still available to assign.
benefit: The summary accounts for income, prior deficits, assignments, and reserved funds.
uncertainty: Currency calculations use integer minor units; display formatting is outside this formula.

name: Manual hold for next month
description: A buffered value on the current month removes selected funds from current To Budget and returns them through the next month carry-in.
user_problem: People paid during a month may wish to reserve income for a future month.
benefit: Users can hold all or part of current positive unassigned money.
uncertainty: Documentation supports multi-month holds by applying holds month by month. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/envelope.ts

name: Hold clamp and reset
description: Hold changes are clamped so buffers cannot become negative or exceed positive To Budget; resetHold sets the buffer to zero.
user_problem: Changing a hold must not create money or reserve more than is available.
benefit: Users can adjust a hold within available limits or return it to this month's To Budget.
uncertainty: holdForNextMonth refuses to update when To Budget is zero or negative.

name: Automatic hold from income categories
description: Envelope buffered-auto adds activity in income categories with carryover enabled; buffered-selected uses the manual amount if nonzero, otherwise the auto total.
user_problem: Repeatedly holding selected income sources is tedious.
benefit: Income category carryover flags can reserve qualifying income automatically.
uncertainty: Docs/UI indicate auto-hold spans the current month and next 12 months; exact UI range is not inferred from this code. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts

name: Move assignments between categories
description: transferCategory subtracts an assignment from the source and adds it to a destination category, or returns it to To Budget; records a movement note.
user_problem: Plans change and funds need reassignment without registering new income or spending.
benefit: Users can move budgeted amounts while keeping actual transaction activity unchanged.
uncertainty: Amount range validation is delegated to callers.

name: Cover category overspending
description: Covering moves funds from To Budget or a category to a negative category, capped at the smaller of deficit and source leftover.
user_problem: A negative category needs explicit funding from available or surplus money.
benefit: Overspending may be covered fully or partially without taking more than the source has.
uncertainty: Falsy explicit amount falls back to full overspending, so zero behaves like no amount. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.test.ts

name: Cover aggregate overbudgeting
description: coverOverbudgeted reduces a positive category assignment by at most its positive leftover, against the negative To Budget total.
user_problem: Users may want to resolve aggregate overbudgeting from a chosen category.
benefit: The action applies a bounded assignment reduction and records a movement note.
uncertainty: No matching focused unit test was found in actions.test.ts.

name: Copy previous month assignments
description: Copies prior month budget amounts into the selected month, skipping hidden categories/groups and income categories in envelope mode.
user_problem: A new month may reuse prior assignments as a starting plan.
benefit: Users can copy expense assignments while retaining income-category assignments in tracking mode.
uncertainty: Copies assignments only, not category balances or actual activity. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.test.ts

name: Tracking category balance formula
description: Tracking category leftover is budgeted plus expense activity or budgeted minus income activity, plus prior balance only when carryover is enabled.
user_problem: Plan-versus-actual tracking needs cumulative balances with optional rollover.
benefit: Tracking mode shows accumulated balance by category without envelope zeroing.
uncertainty: Formula sign differs for income categories.

name: Tracking planned and actual savings totals
description: Tracking summary computes planned saved as budgeted income minus budgeted expenses and real saved as actual income minus actual expenses.
user_problem: Tracking needs separate projected and realized income/expense totals.
benefit: Users can compare planned savings with realized cash flow.
uncertainty: Projected savings is assignment-based, not a net-worth measure.

name: Tracking mode does not auto-roll balances
description: Tracking category carryover defaults false; prior leftover is included only when that category's carryover flag is true.
user_problem: Historical tracking may not want balances accumulating by default.
benefit: Users choose which category balances roll forward.
uncertainty: Includes both source and documentation evidence; tracking overspending behavior differs from envelope mode. Additional source locator: packages/docs/docs/getting-started/tracking-budget.md

name: Hidden categories in totals
description: Tracking group totals exclude hidden categories and groups; envelope group totals aggregate supplied categories and groups.
user_problem: Hidden historical entries can distort visible tracking summaries.
benefit: Tracking totals omit hidden items, while envelope totals preserve their values.
uncertainty: Tests explicitly distinguish tracking and envelope behavior. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/base.test.ts

name: Monthly goal and long-goal values
description: Budget rows store monthly goal and long_goal alongside amount and carryover; categories store reusable goal definitions.
user_problem: A monthly number alone cannot encode longer-term target instructions.
benefit: The data model separates monthly goal context from reusable automation definitions.
uncertainty: Goal field semantics are driven by automation and UI code. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/migrations/1694438752000_add_goal_targets.sql

name: Reusable budget template types
description: Declared automation types include simple, periodic, refill, copy, average, percentage, by-date, spend-by-date, schedule, remainder, limit, and goal.
user_problem: Users need reusable rules for amounts, limits, timing, and target states.
benefit: Category automation can combine budget instructions and goal-only definitions.
uncertainty: Type declarations define shape; behavior varies by template handler.

name: Template priority and available-funds clamp
description: Automation processes priority levels in order, skips nonzero assignments unless forced, uses To Budget for envelope or total-saved for tracking, and clamps priorities as funds run out.
user_problem: Multiple category rules must compete predictably for finite funds.
benefit: Templates preserve user assignments by default and prioritize essential allocations.
uncertainty: Dry-run projections deliberately skip the available-funds clamp. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/goal-template.test.ts

name: Weighted remainder allocation
description: Remainder templates divide residual funds by configured weights, repeating while templates still require funds and progress occurs.
user_problem: After fixed priority targets, remaining money needs a predictable allocation.
benefit: Flexible categories receive proportional shares of remaining funds.
uncertainty: Integer rounding and limits are handled by template context. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/goal-template.test.ts

name: Budget template limits
description: Simple, periodic, and remainder templates may include daily, weekly, or monthly limits, start dates, and a hold flag.
user_problem: Fixed allocations need caps tied to spending history or time periods.
benefit: The automation engine can constrain assigned funds and hold excess.
uncertainty: Limit outcomes depend on recorded spending and selected hold behavior. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/category-template-context.test.ts

name: Schedule-linked budget automation
description: Schedule templates resolve by schedule ID when present, otherwise by trimmed name; they derive amount/date rules and support fixed or percentage adjustments.
user_problem: Recurring bills need budget suggestions tied to actual schedule data.
benefit: Category automation can track a schedule and its adjusted projected cost.
uncertainty: Name fallback supports legacy notes/UI source templates.

name: Schedule monthly contribution math
description: Schedule automation computes pay-month or sinking contributions with distinct yearly, monthly, weekly, and daily normalization based on next due date and balance.
user_problem: Annual or irregular bills should not demand full funding every month.
benefit: The monthly target can spread costs over time and account for saved balance.
uncertainty: Weekly/daily normalization uses calendar-month span; edge tests cover intervals. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/schedule-template.test.ts

name: Completed and past schedules in automation
description: Completed schedules are excluded; past non-repeating or inactive-in-month schedules produce errors.
user_problem: Stale schedules should not silently drive category targets.
benefit: The automation can report unusable schedule timing instead of funding it as current.
uncertainty: User-facing notification rendering is outside the referenced function. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/schedule-template.test.ts

name: Schedule and rule data model
description: Schedules have recurrence configuration, next date, completion/posting flags and linked rule; rules contain stages, conditions, and actions.
user_problem: Scheduled transactions require persistent recurrence and automation metadata.
benefit: The model supports recurring dates, conditions, and transaction transformations.
uncertainty: Recurrence expansion and rule execution are separate implementations. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/types/models/rule.ts

name: Post or complete scheduled transactions
description: Schedules expose posts_transaction, completed and next_date fields; server and end-to-end tests cover posting and completion flows.
user_problem: Upcoming payments need a controlled path into the register.
benefit: A due scheduled transaction can be posted with its schedule association.
uncertainty: Cited tests cover flows, not every recurrence advancement case. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.test.ts

name: Credit cards are ordinary negative-balance accounts
description: Docs say card accounts behave like other accounts with negative balances; purchases reduce categorized envelopes and on-budget transfers do not change total on-budget funds.
user_problem: Dedicated card payment categories can obscure that expense is recorded at purchase time.
benefit: Purchases reduce their spending category; later card payment is an account transfer.
uncertainty: Documented guidance; no special credit-card envelope formula should be inferred from these sources.

name: Pay-in-full card workflow
description: The documented workflow does not create a separate card budget category; purchases use funded categories and payments transfer between on-budget accounts.
user_problem: Card payment timing can disconnect bank cash movement from when a purchase consumes category funds.
benefit: The user can recognize expense at purchase and payment as a later transfer.
uncertainty: Guidance is not enforced by the transaction model.

name: Carrying card debt workflow
description: Guidance recommends capturing existing debt in a debt category and using rollover overspending so negative account debt is not deducted twice from To Budget.
user_problem: Existing debt must be tracked separately from new category-funded purchases.
benefit: Users can separate debt repayment from new spending and avoid duplicate overspending adjustment.
uncertainty: Recommended workflow rather than enforced transaction constraint.

name: Refunds and reimbursements
description: Docs explain returned purchases/reimbursements; monthly category activity sums signed transaction amounts without a special refund branch.
user_problem: A returned purchase should reverse activity in the category that bore it.
benefit: Category balances can reflect refund amounts through normal categorized transactions.
uncertainty: Detailed cases rely on documented guidance; no refund-specific formula was found in envelope.ts. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/base.ts

name: Budget persistence and migrations
description: zero_budgets and reflect_budgets persist month/category amount and carryover; later migrations add goal, long_goal, goal_def and template_settings.
user_problem: Assignments and reusable templates need durable, separate storage.
benefit: Monthly envelope/tracking records are distinct from category automation data.
uncertainty: Historical migration chain shown; current TypeScript types do not capture every SQL default/nullability detail. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/migrations/1694438752000_add_goal_targets.sql

name: Transaction, rule, and schedule relationships
description: Transactions reference account, optional category, transfer, parent, schedule and child splits; schedules link to rules and recurrence state.
user_problem: Ledger entries need durable category, transfer, split and schedule relationships.
benefit: The model supports transfers, split transactions, rules, and scheduled entries.
uncertainty: Transfer pairing and split validation have separate implementations/tests. Additional source locator: packages/loot-core/src/types/models/schedule.ts

name: Account ledger types
description: Accounts distinguish on-budget from off-budget records; transaction categories are cleared on off-budget accounts.
user_problem: Users need assets and liabilities alongside budget cash without mixing them into category funding.
benefit: Separates cash flow budgeting from tracked balances.
uncertainty: Account-type taxonomy and UI wording are not captured here.

name: Transaction ledger fields
description: Transactions carry account date amount payee category notes imported IDs cleared/reconciled flags and split or transfer links.
user_problem: A ledger needs enough provenance and status to reconcile imported and hand-entered activity.
benefit: Keeps ledger display import matching and account balance operations tied to one transaction entity.
uncertainty: Amounts use IntegerAmount; confirm the target ledger's unit convention separately.

name: Split transactions
description: A parent transaction can own categorized child rows whose amounts sum to the parent; distribution divides remainder evenly into empty splits or proportionally across populated splits.
user_problem: One bank transaction may cover purchases from several categories.
benefit: Preserves one bank-side amount while allocating category activity precisely.
source_locator: Creating a Split Transaction and Distributing the Remainder; server/shared transactions recalculateSplit
uncertainty: Documentation requires children to sum to parent; malformed split handling is an error path.

name: Linked transfers
description: Selecting a transfer-account payee creates an equal opposite transaction in the other account and links both rows; edits mirror amount payee notes and schedule.
user_problem: Two manually entered rows look like separate income and spending and distort reports.
benefit: Linked pair can be recognized as money movement between accounts.
uncertainty: Transfer pair creation skips split parents and relies on child transfers.

name: Transfer date and status independence
description: Transfer dates may remain independent to reflect settlement delays; cleared and reconciled states remain account-specific; date-sync preference is optional.
user_problem: Inter-account postings can settle on different statement dates.
benefit: Supports bank statement matching on each side without losing transfer linkage.
source_locator: Modifying a Transfer and Syncing the Transfer Date
uncertainty: Behavior is documented; repository code paths are in server/transactions/transfer.ts.

name: On-budget/off-budget transfer category semantics
description: Transfers between accounts of the same budget class clear category; cross-class transfers retain a category only on the on-budget side.
user_problem: Transfer categorization can otherwise inflate budget activity or misstate outflows.
benefit: Keeps budget reports from treating internal on-budget movement as spending.
source_locator: clearCategory lines 24-45; docs transactions/transfers.md Transfer Categories
uncertainty: Exact report treatment can depend on which transfer half is budgeted.

name: Cleared status
description: Cleared is a per-transaction statement-matched state used to derive cleared and uncleared account totals.
user_problem: Users need a visible bridge between a pending ledger and posted bank activity.
benefit: Makes the account balance discrepancy easier to investigate.
uncertainty: Statement-matching semantics are user workflow; bank transaction status may vary by provider.

name: Reconciliation lock workflow
description: Reconciliation compares user-entered or last-synced statement balance to cleared total; once difference is zero user explicitly locks transactions, and unlock reverts status to cleared.
user_problem: Users can lose confidence when ledger and bank statement balances diverge.
benefit: Guides row-by-row matching and freezes verified rows against accidental edits.
source_locator: Work Flow and Starting the Reconciliation Tool
uncertainty: UI must distinguish cleared from reconciled because these are separate lifecycle states.

name: Payee registry and transfer payees
description: Payees are reusable entities; an account has a transfer payee identifying its destination account and common payees can be surfaced for reuse.
user_problem: Repeated merchant spellings make categorization and search inconsistent.
benefit: Consolidates labels and enables payee-targeted rules and transfers.
source_locator: Payees and transfer payees; API reference transfer_acct
uncertainty: Learning/merge details vary by payee operations.

name: Supported statement file formats
description: Financial-file import accepts CSV TSV QIF OFX QFX and CAMT XML, with OFX/QFX recommended by docs for their richer IDs.
user_problem: Banks expose different download formats and not all offer a common schema.
benefit: Broadens manual import coverage without requiring a bank connector.
uncertainty: The inspected parser routes XML to CAMT; format conformance is parser-specific.

name: Configurable CSV and TSV mapping
description: CSV import supports header/delimiter/date mapping amount flip debit-credit columns multiplier encoding and line skipping options.
user_problem: Banks vary in column order date conventions encodings and debit-credit sign direction.
benefit: Lets users map local bank exports instead of hand-editing files.
source_locator: Import CSV Files; parse-file.ts ParseFileOptions and parseCSV
uncertainty: Some configuration behavior is in desktop-client ImportTransactionsModal.

name: OFX/QFX transaction identifiers
description: OFX parser extracts FITID plus posted date amount name and memo; duplicate logic prioritizes imported IDs.
user_problem: Reimporting an overlapping bank statement can duplicate rows without stable bank IDs.
benefit: Stable IDs give the highest-fidelity deduplication path.
uncertainty: Provider FITID quality and uniqueness are upstream-controlled.

name: QIF parser
description: QIF parser maps date amount number memo address cleared status payee category and category divisions into transaction records.
user_problem: Some banks or legacy tools export QIF rather than OFX.
benefit: Allows legacy file imports with transaction status and split metadata.
uncertainty: Source implementation was inspected; exact edge-case coverage depends on QIF tests.

name: CAMT import
description: An XML parser path handles CAMT statement files in the supported import pipeline.
user_problem: European banks may provide CAMT rather than QIF/OFX.
benefit: Adds regional bank statement compatibility.
uncertainty: Parser test coverage and supported CAMT profile should be checked per source file.

name: Preview import reconciliation
description: Import reconciliation returns added updated and preview rows; already reconciled matches are ignored rather than overwritten.
user_problem: Users need to inspect how incoming entries will merge before changing their ledger.
benefit: Preserves reviewed fields and reduces accidental changes to locked entries.
uncertainty: Exact preview UI presentation resides in ImportTransactionsModal.

name: Import duplicate matching by stable ID
description: Matching first looks up imported_id within the selected account and can match tombstoned rows depending on reimportDeleted.
user_problem: Stable bank references can prevent the same posted transaction being inserted twice.
benefit: Makes repeated downloads idempotent when provider IDs are reliable.
uncertainty: IDs are scoped to account and provider quality is not controlled by the app.

name: Fuzzy duplicate matching
description: Without an exact ID match, candidates need same account amount and a date within seven days; closest date ranks first, then same payee is preferred, then first remaining candidate.
user_problem: Hand-entered items may later arrive via file import or bank sync without a shared stable ID.
benefit: Reduces duplicate rows across manual and imported entry paths.
source_locator: matchTransactions fuzzy query and matching passes 902-1025
uncertainty: Ambiguous same-amount candidates remain a review risk; do not treat fuzzy match as guaranteed identity.

name: Deleted-import handling
description: A per-account preference or explicit option controls whether a previously deleted imported row is eligible for matching and reimport; file UI and API defaults differ.
user_problem: Deleted rows can unexpectedly return or legitimate bank imports can be suppressed.
benefit: Provides a deliberate recovery choice for imports.
source_locator: Avoiding duplicate transactions; API reference reimportDeleted
uncertainty: Docs conflict: importing.md says the file checkbox defaults checked, while API reference says file UI defaults false; API default is true.

name: Merge existing and imported transactions
description: Import prefers imported date and retains existing payee category notes when set, fills missing fields from import, and ORs cleared state; reconciled rows are protected.
user_problem: A matched bank row may contain updated date or cleared status while the user has enriched the local row.
benefit: Updates bank-facing metadata while preserving user-entered categorization and notes.
source_locator: reconcileTransactions field merge and updateDates lines 678-728
uncertainty: Update imported date is option-dependent; merge ignores reconciled/locked transaction updates.

name: Rules applied during import
description: Import runs transaction rules before matching and committing imported rows.
user_problem: Repeated merchants require users to recategorize the same imported activity.
benefit: Rules can automatically assign payees categories notes or splits to new imports.
uncertainty: Rules can influence candidate payee matching and require rule-specific tests.

name: Public Node API transaction import
description: API exposes importTransactions with reconciliation and addTransactions for raw inserts without dedupe; API returns added updated and errors.
user_problem: Custom integrations need a supported path to submit transaction batches.
benefit: Allows programmatic ingestion while distinguishing raw data creation from reconciliation.
uncertainty: API contracts can differ from internal server mutation signatures.

name: Ledger CSV export
description: Export query serializes selected transactions with account date payee notes categories amount cleared and reconciled status, including split metadata.
user_problem: Users need data portability and spreadsheet analysis.
benefit: Produces structured ledger data including child rows and split labels.
uncertainty: Export schema has distinct raw and query paths.

name: Spreadsheet formula injection mitigation
description: CSV string serialization prefixes risky string values beginning with equals plus minus at-sign tabs or carriage returns with an apostrophe.
user_problem: Payee notes or other attacker-controlled strings could be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas.
benefit: Reduces formula execution risk when users open exports in spreadsheet software.
uncertainty: Only the inspected string cast pattern is evidenced; spreadsheet applications vary.

name: Self-hosted bank sync integration boundary
description: Bank sync requires actual-server and user-supplied provider credentials; setup secrets are stored server-side and are outside budget E2EE.
user_problem: A local ledger may need institution connection while users need to understand who can read credentials.
benefit: Keeps provider integration behind a server boundary and makes credential trust explicit.
uncertainty: Server operators can access stored bank tokens; E2EE protects budget data only.

name: SimpleFIN bank sync
description: Users provide a one-use setup token then map remote accounts to existing or newly created Actual accounts; documented history is at most 90 days.
user_problem: Manual file downloads and repeated reconciliation are burdensome.
benefit: Pulls linked-account transactions and balances into the app import workflow.
source_locator: Generate Setup Token Link Accounts Considerations
uncertainty: Upstream update cadence varies; user-owned SimpleFIN account and token needed.

name: GoCardless BankAccountData
description: Provider supports linked bank retrieval for existing users, with current docs warning that new Bank Account Data accounts are no longer accepted since July 2025.
user_problem: European institutions may need aggregated account access.
benefit: Retains a migration path for existing GoCardless-linked Actual users.
uncertainty: Provider onboarding availability and quotas are external and time-sensitive.

name: Pluggy.ai bank sync
description: Brazilian provider setup uses client credentials and an item connection then links provider accounts to Actual accounts.
user_problem: Brazilian institution exports may not be convenient for ongoing sync.
benefit: Connects supported Brazilian accounts through a provider-backed workflow.
uncertainty: Provider refresh frequency and credentials remain third-party controlled.

name: Enable Banking EU sync
description: Enable Banking supports an experimental European open-banking flow using a configured app ID credential and consent linking.
user_problem: Regional bank connectivity may require a PSD2 aggregator.
benefit: Extends account sync for European institutions.
uncertainty: Docs warn stable release may not contain all functionality; nightly may be required.

name: Akahu NZ sync
description: Akahu is an experimental New Zealand bank connector configured with app and user access tokens and explicit account linking.
user_problem: New Zealand institutions need a regional connector.
benefit: Offers a path to link NZ accounts for transaction import.
uncertainty: Feature remains experimental; token scope and institutional availability are external.

name: Automatic bank sync scheduling
description: Automatic sync is off by default, runs only while app is open, and supports standard or custom intervals with a 15-minute minimum; overdue accounts trigger a batch over linked accounts.
user_problem: Users may forget to refresh linked accounts.
benefit: Reduces manual refresh while keeping the user in control of provider polling cadence.
uncertainty: Bank provider rate limits apply and behavior requires sync server reachability.

name: Provider-specific history limits
description: GoCardless sync start date is bounded by existing oldest transaction or the last 90 days, whichever is later; docs also state SimpleFIN at most 90 days.
user_problem: Providers may not supply full historical data and users need matching boundaries.
benefit: Avoids requesting unsupported history while supporting incremental import.
uncertainty: Provider history can be shorter than requested and integrations may differ.

name: Local-first offline ledger
description: Budget data is stored on the local device and selected server; the app can work without network and sync changes when connectivity returns.
user_problem: Users need access to records when traveling or offline.
benefit: Maintains local access and eventual cross-device continuity.
uncertainty: Offline operation depends on the client storage platform and sync backlog.

name: End-to-end encryption for sync
description: Optional client-side E2EE encrypts budget data before it reaches the chosen server and requires a second password on each new device.
user_problem: A self-hosted or shared server operator may otherwise read budget contents.
benefit: Reduces server-side exposure of budget data.
source_locator: End-to-End Encryption and encryption/index.ts createKey encrypt decrypt
uncertainty: Local data remains unencrypted by app-level E2EE; lost password plus lost local copy is unrecoverable.

name: Sync reset and recovery
description: Reset sync makes one device authoritative, clears server sync state and changes sync ID; other devices must revert/download current data before resuming.
user_problem: Restore or divergence can leave devices with conflicting sync histories.
benefit: Provides a guided rebootstrap and recovery route after restore or encryption changes.
source_locator: Resetting Sync and Debugging Sync Issues
uncertainty: Unsynced changes on other devices are reverted; choose authoritative device carefully.

name: Backup and restore
description: Users can export a budget archive; desktop keeps up to 10 automatic backups with up to three same-day copies and supports loading/reverting backups.
user_problem: Accidental edits upgrades or file corruption can threaten long-running ledger history.
benefit: Creates a recovery point independent of bank import and sync state.
uncertainty: Automatic backups are desktop-only; manual export/restore is separate and old schemas may need migration.

name: Configurable report dashboard
description: Default Reports page plus customizable dashboards and report widgets.
user_problem: Users need a reusable overview of their own finances.
benefit: Pin relevant financial summaries together for faster review.
uncertainty: Current live docs and pinned source clone agree.

name: Multiple dashboards
description: Users can create multiple dashboard pages, each with its own widgets.
user_problem: One overview cannot serve different review purposes.
benefit: Keep separate views for cash flow net worth or household questions.
uncertainty: Docs say many; deletion guard prevents removing last dashboard.

name: Built-in report widgets
description: Reports include Cash Flow Net Worth Spending Analysis Summary Calendar Text and Crossover Point; some other reports are marked experimental.
user_problem: Users need ready-to-use high-level views.
benefit: Get common historical and planning summaries without assembling queries.
source_locator: Reports Dashboard built-in and experimental lists; repo packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/ChooseGraph.tsx
uncertainty: Exact widget availability can evolve; experimental status is explicit in docs.

name: Custom report chart types
description: Custom transaction reports support table bar line area and donut presentations.
user_problem: Transaction totals are hard to inspect from one representation.
benefit: Choose tabular detail or a visual summary for the same report.
uncertainty: Some report/type combinations disable options.

name: Custom report breakdowns
description: Reports can split transaction totals by category group payee account or month and by total or time mode.
user_problem: Users want to compare spending along different dimensions.
benefit: Reveal who where and when money moved.
uncertainty: Split by account means transaction sums on budget and not periodic account balances.

name: Custom report live and fixed periods
description: Date controls use live relative ranges or static date boundaries.
user_problem: Reports become stale or lose historic comparison ranges.
benefit: Reopen current-period reports dynamically or preserve a fixed analysis window.
uncertainty: Live range presets can be version-sensitive.

name: Custom report filters and exclusions
description: Reports support transaction filters plus hidden empty off-budget uncategorized and excluded category/group options, subject to chart availability.
user_problem: A useful aggregate can be distorted by irrelevant transactions or categories.
benefit: Focus a report on the transactions that answer the question.
uncertainty: Off-budget transfers have documented exclusions; disabled items are not available for every chart.

name: Save and revise custom reports
description: Saved reports can be overwritten saved as a new report reverted to saved values or discarded when leaving; dashboard cards list saved reports alphabetically.
user_problem: Repeat analysis requires rebuilding its settings.
benefit: Reuse a report and safely explore changes.
uncertainty: Changes not explicitly saved are discarded when leaving.

name: Dashboard widget organization
description: Dashboard pages support adding removing copying and repositioning widgets, plus page rename reset and import/export workflows.
user_problem: A generic dashboard may not match a user's priorities.
benefit: Shape a persistent overview and reuse/share its layout file.
uncertainty: Import/export operates on dashboard definitions; not a claim of sharing private budget data.

name: Net worth by account
description: Net Worth reports all-account balances over time and offers trend and stacked account modes including off-budget accounts.
user_problem: Household net worth spans cash assets and debts outside the spending budget.
benefit: Track overall balances and see account contributions over time.
source_locator: Net Worth Graph; https://actualbudget.org/docs/tour/reports/ net worth description
uncertainty: Docs describe account balances; no securities-level holdings or quote feed established by reviewed evidence.

name: Cash flow history
description: Cash Flow shows balances in budgeted accounts over time with income and expense visualizations.
user_problem: Users need to understand how spending and income affect available cash.
benefit: Review historical cash-on-hand movement.
uncertainty: Budgeted accounts only; not net worth.

name: Crossover Point projection
description: Crossover Point projects selected persistent expenses and investment account income to estimate when passive income covers expenses.
user_problem: Users want a long-range financial-independence scenario.
benefit: Compare an estimated withdrawal stream against projected expenses.
source_locator: Crossover Point / Input Parameters / How It Works
uncertainty: Planning estimate rather than investment advice; historical account return can include contributions and inflate returns per docs.

name: Experimental reports
description: Budget Analysis Balance Forecast Sankey and Monte Carlo Analysis are explicitly listed as experimental reports.
user_problem: Users may mistake emerging functionality for stable core reporting.
benefit: Explore additional analysis with its maturity visible.
uncertainty: The docs link to experimental feature pages; feature status may change.

name: ActualQL transaction queries
description: Official Node API ActualQL supports selecting filtering sorting grouping and aggregate expressions over budget data.
user_problem: Built-in reports may not answer a custom question.
benefit: Enable custom local analysis and integrations without adding a new UI report type.
uncertainty: Docs call language mostly undocumented; query semantics require developer fluency. Additional source locator: https://actualbudget.org/docs/api/actual-ql/functions/

name: ActualQL split handling
description: Transaction queries expose inline grouped or all split behaviors so aggregation can account for parent and subtransactions deliberately.
user_problem: Naive sums can double-count splits or omit desired parent information.
benefit: Choose the representation appropriate to an analysis.
uncertainty: Important correctness caveat for custom query authors.

name: Actual API is a local Node client
description: Official API package interacts with a running Actual instance and accesses local budget data; server does not expose a general REST API.
user_problem: Users may expect conventional remote HTTP reporting endpoints.
benefit: Integrations can use the supported client model with accurate deployment assumptions.
uncertainty: API docs describe package behavior; not a generic web-service feature.

name: Sidebar navigation and start page
description: Settings can show reorder and choose a start page for desktop sidebar destinations; hidden pages remain in Settings navigation.
user_problem: Frequent destinations may be buried in the default sidebar.
benefit: Put routine destinations in preferred order and open on a useful page.
uncertainty: Docs state these settings live in the budget file and follow it across devices.

name: Mobile navigation configuration gap
description: Settings documentation says mobile layout does not yet use customized sidebar visibility ordering or start-page settings.
user_problem: Desktop navigation customization may not carry through to phone use.
benefit: Keep mobile navigation expectations clear when documenting navigation parity.
uncertainty: This is a docs statement; it does not imply that mobile lacks all report access.

name: Settings presentation and formatting
description: Settings provides page-based navigation for appearance number/date formatting language and other budget/system settings.
user_problem: Users need to tune display and find administrative controls.
benefit: Support locale-friendly display and centralized configuration.
uncertainty: Locale display settings do not imply multi-currency arithmetic.

name: No native multi-currency accounting
description: Official documentation says Actual is currency-agnostic and does not support multi-currency natively.
user_problem: Cross-currency account balances cannot be treated as automatically converted consolidated values.
benefit: Avoid comparing unlike currency amounts as if converted.
uncertainty: Docs link a separate implementation-status project; no native conversion evidence found in inspected source/docs.

name: Manual experimental FX rule workaround
description: Docs describe rule templates that manually multiply foreign-account transactions by a fixed FX rate and save the original amount/rate in notes.
user_problem: People need a workaround for a foreign currency account.
benefit: Record a manually converted amount while retaining source context.
uncertainty: Explicitly experimental and manual; requires two rules per account and applying rules to transactions.

name: Encryption scope in settings
description: Settings docs say end-to-end encryption applies to budget data on remote server while bank-sync tokens are stored separately and excluded.
user_problem: Privacy expectations can exceed the actual encryption boundary.
benefit: Make an informed choice about self-hosting and encryption scope.
uncertainty: Scope from documentation; local plaintext and other deployment details need their own evidence.

name: MIT package declaration mismatch
description: Repository root license text is MIT, desktop-client package declares MIT, while loot-core package metadata declares ISC.
user_problem: A single product-wide license label can obscure package provenance.
benefit: Preserve per-file and per-package license checks before reusing code.
source_locator: Root LICENSE.txt; packages/loot-core/package.json license=ISC; packages/desktop-client/package.json license=MIT
uncertainty: Metadata and root license text differ; inspect provenance and applicable headers for every reused component.
